# Discussion — <question>

[Final analysis](<relative link>) · [Measurements](<relative link>)

## Question and controlled comparison

Name the single decision, what is held fixed, and any inseparable changes.

## Observed measurements

Link the exact result files and representative plans. Define derived scores and spread.

## Mechanism and alternatives

Distinguish observed work from hypotheses. Explain what the plans do and do not establish.

## Exchange with other analyses

Cite authors by analysis_id. Preserve disagreement and explain whether evidence, scope,
or assumptions differ. Do not manufacture participation or agreement by another model.

## Where the measurement is weak

Name missing controls, errors, duration/sample limits, and environment hazards.

## Discriminating next experiment

Give a runnable comparison and what outcome would change the conclusion.
